descriptionText: A tiny elf-like fey at the center of a brightly colored mote of winged light.
lore: Sprites’ colors mirror their rapidly changing moods; they encourage heroes and enjoy harmless pranks.
name: Sprite
tactics: Supports allies with Soothing Words, Exposing Light, ranged Help, and automatic Empathetic Support.

abilities.details: Can share creature Spaces and move through air-sized gaps as Difficult Terrain.
abilities.name: Cloud Body

abilities.details: Creatures occupying your Space are Slowed, Blinded, and Deafened.
abilities.name: Storm Body

abilities.details: When Bloodied, become 1 Size smaller and Attacks have DisADV. When Well-Bloodied, become 2 Sizes smaller and Attacks have DisADV 2.
abilities.name: Diminishing Size

abilities.details: Ranged Spell Attack vs AD, 10 Spaces, 3 Lightning and ignores Close Range Penalty. Chain (+1 AP, repeatable): add a target within 3 Spaces of the previous target using the same Check.
abilities.name: Lightning Strike

abilities.details: Against creatures in Spaces you occupy: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 2 Bludgeoning +1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.
abilities.name: Hail

abilities.details: Against Large or smaller creatures in a 1 Space Aura: Contest, Spell Check vs Physical Save. Success pulls 1 Space toward your center, +1 per Success (each 5).
abilities.name: Vortex Pull

abilities.details: Contest in a 5 Space Aura, Spell Check vs Might Save. Success causes Dazed and Stunned for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Booming Thunder

descriptionText: A dense living torrent of rain clouds, hail, lightning, and deafening thunder.
immunities: Lightning, Poison; Bleeding, Blinded, Burning, Deafened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Tethered, Unconscious
lore: Storm Elementals are chaotic embodiments of thunderstorms whose emotions shift as quickly as the weather.
name: Storm Elemental
tactics: Strikes at range with lightning, pelts creatures inside its body with Hail, pulls enemies inward, and uses Booming Thunder to Daze and Stun groups.

abilities.details: Can share creature Spaces and move through gaps as small as a member of the swarm, treating them as Difficult Terrain.
abilities.name: Swarm

abilities.details: Cannot heal or gain Temp HP. When Bloodied, become 1 Size smaller with DisADV on Attacks; when Well-Bloodied, become 2 Sizes smaller with DisADV 2.
abilities.name: Significant Diminishing Numbers

abilities.details: DisADV on Attacks against creatures not revealed by Echo unless they Attacked you since your last turn ended.
abilities.name: Poor Eyesight

abilities.details: Reveal all creatures within 15 Spaces to yourself and creatures with Echosight for 1 Round. Louder (+1 AP): against creatures in your Spaces, Contest Martial Check vs Mental Save; Success Dazes for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Echo

abilities.details: Melee Attack vs AD, 1 Piercing. Bleed (+1 AP): Agility Save failure causes Bleeding. Impair (+1 AP): Might Save failure Impairs for 1 Round as a Basic Disease.
abilities.name: Swarm

descriptionText: A loud mass of small brown bats flapping and screeching together.
lore: Bat colonies attack when threatened or magically controlled.
name: Swarm of Bats
tactics: Uses Echo to locate and Daze enemies, then Swarms occupied Spaces to cause Bleeding and Impaired.

abilities.details: ADV on Awareness Checks made to hear or smell.
abilities.name: Keen Senses

abilities.details: Gain an additional +2 bonus to Attacks against creatures you’re Flanking.
abilities.name: Pack Tactics

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Piercing. Grapple (+1 AP): Might Save failure Grapples. Slow (+1 AP): Agility Save failure Slows until the end of the target’s next turn.
abilities.name: Bite

abilities.details: Against a Grappled target: Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Piercing; Physical Save failure causes Bleeding.
abilities.name: Tear Apart

descriptionText: A large savage canine with sharp teeth and claws that howls to begin a hunt.
lore: Wolves live in packs and threaten settlements when they begin hunting livestock near civilization.
name: Wolf
tactics: Bites and Grapples a target, then Flanks it with the pack and uses Tear Apart.

abilities.details: ADV on Awareness Checks made to hear or smell.
abilities.name: Keen Senses

abilities.details: Gain an additional +2 bonus to Attacks against creatures you’re Flanking.
abilities.name: Pack Tactics

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 4 Piercing +1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.
abilities.name: Bite

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 3 Slashing; Physical Save failure Grapples, and Failure (5) also Restrains while Grappled.
abilities.name: Talon

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Space Aura, 3 Bludgeoning; Physical Save failure knocks Prone.
abilities.name: Wing Strike

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Spaces, 1 Piercing; Might Save failure deals 2 Poison at the start of each turn for 1 minute as a Basic Poison.
abilities.name: Stinger

abilities.details: Contest in a 5 Space Aura, Intimidation vs Repeated Charisma Save. Success Intimidates for 1 minute.
abilities.name: Intimidating Roar

descriptionText: A two-legged dragon with a barbed tail, a smell of rot, and a terrifying roar.
lore: Wyverns hunt large prey in mountain ranges and desert mesas, often in pairs or packs.
name: Wyvern
tactics: Grabs creatures with Talons and flies away, Bites lone targets, Wing Strikes groups, poisons with its Stinger, and Intimidates with a roar.

abilities.details: The only way to be reduced below 1 HP is by a Heavy Hit or an Attack that deals Radiant damage.
abilities.name: Unrelenting

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Bludgeoning. Grapple (+1 AP): Might Save failure Grapples.
abilities.name: Strike

abilities.details: Against a Grappled target: Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 2 Piercing. Infect (+2 AP): Repeated Might Save failure Impairs for 1 minute as a Basic Disease.
abilities.name: Bite

descriptionText: A reeking animated corpse that groans while slowly trudging toward living flesh.
lore: Zombies rise through necromancy or uncleansed necrotic magic and can gather into hordes.
name: Zombie
tactics: Mindlessly Strikes and Grapples a creature, then Bites and Infects it.
